task: R7 W11 actual scalar codegen independent review
decision_basis: Actual ordinary finite mul traverses only 89 encoded bytes at 26 instruction sites; it jumps over inline LowScale. No linked placement, dynamic profile or timing supports a new noinline variant.

evidence_scope.object_hash_provenance: Recorded pre/post inspection hashes, equal in W11 metadata; binaries absent locally, so not independently rehashed here.
evidence_scope.fresh_verification: Used C, command records, raw objdump/readelf text and fixed runtime header were rehashed locally and compared to both internal manifests.
evidence_scope.disassembly_view: evidence/elf/raw/<Module>/objdump-disassembly.stdout (-drwC); line references do not use derived objdump-parsed-view line numbering.
evidence_scope.object_kind: ELF64 ET_REL diagnostic objects, section-relative offsets; no linked virtual addresses.

findings.claim: W11 source is exact public 60f. Five actual C files and export objects are bound by Lake clang commands to the same staged source and -O3 -ffp-contract=off compilation; no LTO flag appears.

Both full VerifyFull/benchFull target attempts timed out (600s and 100s, exit 124). Raw tails remain in dependency compilation and contain no confirmed final benchFull linker invocation; benchFull exists=false. Separate requested C/object facets exited 0. The resume MainFull:c.o record is Replayed, not a fresh compile.

MainFull static closures point to local boxed add/mul lambdas. Legacy and suite scalar loops still call lean_apply_2. Lean has cloned candidate arithmetic into MainFull local bodies; callbacks do not directly dispatch to the standalone Submission_mul symbol.

findings.topic: UInt32 boxed ABI does not imply per-call heap allocation
findings.claim: On this ELF64 target UInt32 arguments/results use tagged immediates. The 116-byte MainFull boxed wrapper tag-tests/unboxes, directly calls its local unboxed body, and returns (uint32<<1)|1. Its only cold calls are reference decrements for nonscalar inputs; no allocator target is present. Static scalar closures have m_rc=0.
findings.not_claimed: No claim that lean_apply_2 runtime internals, all backend branches, or the complete benchmark allocate nothing.

findings.topic: Separate genuine allocation sites from per-item arithmetic
findings.claim: Suite pair constructors and generator/pass closures are setup. The scalar per-item loop's apply_2 precedes checksum/update/backedge; its 16-byte mi_malloc_small call is in the loop-termination IO-result path, once per completed pass rather than per scalar element.
findings.timing_boundary: Input Array/pair construction occurs before measure. Pass-result construction belongs to each timed pass; not a per-item UInt32 boxing cost.

findings.claim: MainFull legacy/suite mul bodies are 884 bytes and byte-identical with matching transfer targets. Their ordinary finite branch traverses entry [0x0,0x32) and native [0x20a,0x231), totaling 89 encoded bytes / 26 instruction sites. The 894-byte standalone Submission_mul has the same ordinary path count, with native block shifted to [0x214,0x23b).
findings.count_meaning: Static encoded bytes/instruction sites on this path, excluding callees and outer ABI; not cycles or dynamic branch-frequency measurements.
findings.noinline_reason: LowScale remains inlined, but ordinary execution already jumps over it. C/function total size alone supplies no new layout-performance evidence.

findings.claim: Actual normal MainFull mul retains two calls to lean_float32_of_bits and one tail jump to lean_float32_to_bits. lean_float32_mul becomes mulss. The first decoded value is spilled to the stack across the second external decode call.
findings.erased_wrappers: ExecFloat nominal/subtype/constructor/projection wrappers and inline Float32 mul primitive no longer impose separate calls here.
findings.preserved_boundary: Underlying Float32.ofBits/toBits external calls remain. No cycles or removable-cost estimate is available.

findings.topic: Add and low-path calls are conditional
findings.claim: MainFull add has conditional of_bits sites at +0x44/+0xa2 and final to_bits tail jump +0xe9; numeric branches use cvtsi2ss, scale table and mulss. MainFull mul's specialized software backend, uint32_of_big_nat and cold ref decrement sites are outside the ordinary finite path.
findings.caveat: Do not charge all static calls or both add decode alternatives to every invocation.

findings.claim: Under the fixed separately compiled official harness, a Kernel change can alter the arithmetic body and its MainFull clone, but has no demonstrated way to remove the Bench loop's generic lean_apply_2 interface. Whether a smaller candidate body changes the inner boxed-wrapper direct call/inlining is UNKNOWN and requires fresh actual objects.
findings.next_falsifier: Only revisit selective noinline after measured instruction-cache/placement evidence or a separately justified candidate yields actual object changes; then compare exact MainFull closures and a complete paired official benchmark.

limits.changes: Only scalar-actual-codegen-w11-review.md/.json; no candidate, R, Git, CI, upload or toolchain installation.
